title: Blackjack
tagline: A multiplayer blackjack game with configurable players, betting and a complete round summary
summary: A multiplayer blackjack game with configurable players, chip-based betting, dealer and player hands, and the standard hit, stand, double and surrender actions. Five screenshots follow the interface from setup and betting through an active hand, results and updated balances, while the video records a complete play-through. The surviving page does not identify the language or libraries, so the technology list remains empty.

hero.alt: Blackjack start screen on green felt with settings, player controls, poker chips and a jack of hearts

sections.heading: Game walkthrough
body: The round moves from choosing the number of players and starting balances to placing bets, playing each hand and reviewing the new balances.

media.alt: Blackjack setup screen for choosing the number of players and each player's starting balance
Betting screen for five players with a minimum bet of ten and colored chip controls
Five-player blackjack round with the dealer showing a four and player five choosing an action on sixteen
Round results overlay showing the dealer on twenty and each player's won or lost result
Final balance summary for all five players with a Play Again button
Screen recording of a complete Blackjack game being played from start to finish, demonstrating every feature.
media.caption: This shows a full play through of the game and all of its features.
